summary: Round 3 features (admin dynamic pricing config, dynamic pabili fee with weight/item_count, dynamic ride fare + zone_distance persistence, ETA on ride & order, admin Users/Orders search boxes, tracking-screen ETA + pabili receipt breakdown, activity card → completed order receipt) validated end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 new-feature pytest cases pass (test_round3_pricing_eta.py). Ride fare 25 + 12*zd and pabili fee 35 + 5*kg + 3*item; after admin POST /api/admin/config the public GET /api/config immediately reflects new values and new orders use the new pricing. GET /api/rides/{id} returns eta_minutes that decreases requested→accepted→arriving→in_progress and is 0 on completed. GET /api/orders/{id} returns eta_minutes by status (25/20/15/8/0). Frontend admin: Pricing tab renders all 7 config fields with testIDs (config-base_fare etc), Save persists (verified by navigating away & back — pabili_per_kg 5→7→5). Users tab search filters 31→2 for 'Tonyo'. Orders tab search filters 24→8 for 'Camflora'. Customer Pabili custom-list: entering item count=4 and weight=3 kg live-updates 'Estimated delivery fee' to ₱62 and after submit backend returns service_fee=62 — tracking screen shows Est. arrival ~25 min plus Delivery fee ₱62. Preset store: 3 items + 2 kg → live Delivery fee ₱54, Estimated total ₱358 (2×₱52 + 1×₱200 + ₱54) — track screen shows Delivery fee ₱54 and Est. arrival ~25 min. Activity card tap opens completed order receipt (ORDER DETAILS section w/ items, weight, driver, delivery fee) at /track/pabili/{id}. Regression: iteration_1 (26/26) and iteration_2 (15/15) suites remain intact — no changes required.

react_native_issues.component: shadow* style props (multiple screens via /app/frontend/src/theme.ts SHADOW.card)
react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web deprecation warning persists: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Cosmetic on web preview. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts (SHADOW.card).
React Native Web deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Cosmetic; migrate JSX pointerEvents prop into style.

(Optional polish) Move JSX pointerEvents props into style={{ pointerEvents: ... }}.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1112 lines (up from 908) — past the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting: config/pricing router, rides router, orders router, admin router, driver router.
get_config() correctly merges DEFAULT_CONFIG with DB overrides so partial updates work (server.py:243-249). Good.
compute_pabili_fee uses max(0.0, weight_kg or 0) & max(0, item_count or 0) guarding against negative values (server.py:262-265). Good.
compute_fare uses max(base_fare, computed) so short trips can never dip below base (server.py:255-260). Good.
ride_eta correctly returns 0 for completed/cancelled and progressively decreases during arriving/in_progress (server.py:267-283). Good.
POST /api/orders derives item_count from preset qtys when body.item_count not set (server.py:522-524). Good fallback.
POST /admin/config rejects empty body with 422 (server.py:650-651). Good input validation.
Config is a single doc keyed by id='pricing' (upsert). No versioning/history — acceptable for MVP but consider audit log later.
Admin config update returns full merged config (server.py:653) so the client can update state atomically. Good UX.
